title: Demonstração ao vivo!
concept: TV-shopping live-demo parody: the real KizuBot gameplay clip plays inside the CRT while presenter speech bubbles and a telestrator point at it ('Olha ele caçando sozinho!', 'Ninguém no teclado!', 'Usando os golpes certinho!', 'E ainda coleta o loot!'), then 'E se aparecer shiny?' → 'Ele te avisa!' with a real shiny-alarm print, the slogan 'Você dorme. Ele farma.' and the end card.
claims: gameplay real do KizuBot (clip de kizubot.com/download)
alarmes no celular e notificações no WhatsApp

notes: Clip: kit/video/rypherior.mp4 (original, no safe version needed), seven cuts at media 12.4, 4.5, 18.6, 0.4, 26.1, 29.4 and 13.0 s, each a muted root-level-window <video> with its own data-start/data-duration/data-media-start; frames verified advancing in snapshots. The lower third says 'GAMEPLAY REAL DO KIZUBOT'; 'AO VIVO' is the parody TV bug (the clip is a recording); nothing is captioned 'boss'. Added 'E ainda coleta o loot!' (telestrator on the loot icons that pop at ~27.5 s; loot is part of BRIEF's Combat module). The shiny alarm is a separate real customer print (shiny-cubone--alarm.png, tagged 'print real de cliente') and isn't presented as coming from this clip. Added the approved slogan 'Você dorme. Ele farma.' before the end card. End ask = the pinned question as a question.
